axis: a bare instance named → an instance the word passes verdict on

members.tone: Flatly dismissive - the thing is put forward as an example and judged to fall short of being one.
Rueful where *excuse* is blunt - the same verdict of inadequacy, delivered with a wince rather than a sneer.
Neutral, and the instance is offered to make the class visible - explanatory work that *instance* makes no claim to.
The barest of the neutral terms - one case counted off, with none of the demonstrative purpose of *illustration*.
The plain unmarked word for a typical item, carrying neither the explanatory duty of *illustration* nor the scrutiny of *specimen*.
Positional rather than evaluative - the instance is defined by not fitting the rule, and the word passes no judgement on it for that.
Clinical - the instance is held up and inspected as a stand-in for its class, where *example* merely names it.
Gives the instance forward reach - an example that licenses what comes after it rather than just typifying a group.
